definition: Every matched raw waypoint receive time minus its scheduled semantic-phase release, compared to the unchanged bound nominal waypoint time; strict abs difference < per-phase tau

separation.method: Independent quadratic minimization of 3D relative position on every adjacent exported SIM truth grid segment; no production assess_separation import

interpretation.supported_observation: Observe-phase delay increases along the route; pre-terminal waypoint violations occur before terminal hold/confirmation, so terminal hold alone cannot explain AC4 failure.
interpretation.bounded_inference: The growth across alternating scan and lane-change intervals is consistent with finite acceleration and corner/lane-change dynamics omitted by a uniform-speed nominal model; this is an inference, not a uniquely identified controller cause.
interpretation.not_caused_by_phase_barrier_overhead: Each phase nominal comparison restarts at its own scheduled release; preceding phase upload/wait time does not accumulate into observe nominal deviation.
interpretation.no_acceptance_change: The user-authorized tau, nominal definition, flight parameters and thresholds are unchanged; no later V jobs started by this review.
